Title: Karan's Day

Cast

1. Karan - 31 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Sunita - 63 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Nitin - 68 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama
4. Sanjay - 28 years, friend
Look: moustache, checked shirt

Places

1. The potter's yard - a wheel, clay pots
2. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights

Scene 1: The potter's yard - Day

[Karan stands in the yard. Sunita and Nitin stand near him.]

Nitin: "Today feels like a good day."

[Karan shapes a clay pot on the potter's wheel.]

Karan: "I'm ready!"

[Karan paints the clay lamps.]

Karan: "Dad, listen!"

Scene 2: The main road - Day

[Karan stands on the road. Sunita and Nitin stand near him.]

Karan: "Mom, look over here."

[Karan starts the car, turns the steering wheel and drives off.]

Nitin: "One more time!"

[Karan steps on the accelerator and speeds away in his car.]

Karan (excited): "And then?"

[Karan's bike skids on the wet road and he falls off.]

Sunita: "I'm ready!"

[A dog runs in front of Karan's car; he brakes hard and swerves just in time.]

Sunita: "Nitin, are you okay?"

[Karan loses his balance on the bicycle and falls.]

Karan (softly): "Careful!"

[Karan is killed when a truck hits him.]

Nitin: "We have to be strong now."
